name: WFMFormat.exe
description: Command-line tool used for pretty-print a dump file generated by Message Farm Analyzer tool.
author: Tim Baker

commands.description: Executes the file `tracerpt.exe` in the same folder as `WFMFormat.exe`. If the file `dumpfile.txt` (any content) exists in the current working directory, no arguments are required. Note that `WFMFormat.exe` requires .NET Framework 3.5.

detection: tracerpt.exe processes located anywhere other than c:\windows\system32
